input: Can I return headphones 20 days after delivery?
reference: Yes. Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, in original packaging.

input: I already sent the item back. How long until I get my money?
reference: Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days after the warehouse receives the item.

input: How long is the warranty on a laptop?
reference: Laptops have a 24-month (2-year) manufacturer warranty that does not cover accidental damage.
